It implements the consequence the liquidity plan set for H7m closing as not testable as stated (eleonorabjornberg/repo-market-liquidity docs/research/plan.md:193-194; docs/stages/h7m-verdict.md; docs/stages/phase3-exit.md; liquidity#198, PR #199): 'Effort then goes to H7f with R+S alone.'
hypothesis: H7 (reserve scarcity can be tracked), step 2, milestone H7.M2: the development nested forecast test (H7f) with R+S alone, against H5's candidate. Development tier
question: Does the scarcity reading, R+S, improve H5's primary score as an input, on development data? R is the plain reserves ratio (repo_model.scarcity.reserves_ratio); S is the current scarcity state (repo_model.scarcity.reserve_scarcity_state, the own-leg read of #586). No liquidity estimator is involved: none is eligible.
target: spread_bps at the scored day, in basis points, as a 23-quantile distribution at each lead h = 1..5 (scoring_protocol.GRID)
decision_instant: 18:00 America/New_York on the decision day (repo_model.decision_instant.DECISION_TIME, #1312). The walks are made at that instant and the instant is pinned for the run (scripts/s3c_flagnet_gross_1321.decision_instant_pinned). R and S are built at the same instant: the legs are read through InformationRule at 18:00, the H.4.1 legs per release (h41_release.release_dated_registry, #541, #622), the daily ON RRP leg at its own latest public row.

step_1_what_the_candidate_reads.note: Established from the code before any score and written to result.json (candidate_reads) by the script; the page states it first. If the candidate had read both R and S, the step would report that as the result and H7f would be answered by construction; it reads neither.
step_1_what_the_candidate_reads.state_S: No. (s3c-ann-net) is the sized arm of #1172 with the scarcity state held at its maximum (repo_model.s3c_net.constant_states): the sized settlement regressor size / SIZE_UNIT * level(state) is the plain signed net over USD 100 bn. The earlier 'scarcity state read per leg' row of #1483 was a different contrast (every term times the state, an interaction); S as an additive input has not been measured on the candidate.
step_1_what_the_candidate_reads.ratio_R: No. The candidate's terms are the calendar and settlement terms (cal.NO_FOMC_IORB with the net settlement sizes), its scale is the median absolute daily change of the spread (spread_mr_fhs, #941), and its cap reads the SRF line from the policy register. No reserves series is read.
step_1_what_the_candidate_reads.arm_adds: both, R and S, and nothing else

arm.name: sc_s3c_ann_net_rs
arm.form: (s3c-ann-net) with R and S as two extra terms after the candidate's terms (repo_model.spread_mr_state_calendar.RS_EXTRAS, served by repo_model.s3c_rs): rs_ratio, R in percentage points of reserves over H.8 total assets of all commercial banks; rs_state, S over 3 (0 abundant, 1 scarce) as spread_mr_state_calendar.level gives it. Everything else is the candidate's: the Huber fit (k = 1.345), the ridge of 5, the pool of standardised residuals, the direct pairs, the net settlement terms and the SRF cap (margin 0)
arm.units: chosen before any score and not tuned; the ridge of 5 is the candidate's and is not changed for the new terms
arm.reference: sc_s3c_ann_net, the candidate, re-run in the same walk on the same days

reads.R: the reserves-to-assets ratio a forecast made at the decision row reads: reserve_balances and bank_total_assets, each at its own latest row public at the decision instant (asof.InformationRule; repo_model.s3c_rs.read_legs); both H.4.1 legs per release
reads.S: repo_model.scarcity.reserve_scarcity_state of those two legs and the day's on_rrp, each at its own latest public row (the own-leg read of #586, her ruling on #571): 0 to 3, a hole when a leg is a hole
reads.alignment: A state of the DECISION row, not a scheduled field of the target row. The value of a training pair with target row T at lead h is the column at T - h, the decision row of the direct pair; a forecast made at decision row d reads the column at d whatever the lead (as repo_model.s3c_satiation). A training pair whose decision row has no value raises ValueError; a forecast whose decision row has none enters at 0. repo_model.s3c_rs.check_rs_no_future refuses a column that depends on a later row (LookAheadError), run on every row
reads.calendar: the calendar and settlement terms are the candidate's, read at the target day (training_pairs = 'direct'; spread_mr_state_calendar.fit_state_terms is guarded by one_step_guard with no allow-list entry); R and S are not calendar or scheduled columns

arms.name: sc_s3c_ann_net_rs
arms.role: (s3c-ann-net) with R and S as two extra terms

benchmark_reading: B1, B1' (#960) and B2 on the 23-level grid, the arm and the candidate each against them, in the orientation d = S(benchmark) - S(model). B3 is the published v1 declaration's five levels (0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95), scored on those five against the arm and the candidate read at the same five (scoring_protocol.level_crps, on_levels), on the decision days on which docs/runs/published_distribution_daily_h{1..5}.json has all five leads, as the protocol's section 4 and #1482 do. B3 is a secondary comparison. The record is read, never edited.

frame.windows: the two windows of #1255, loaded as #1483 and #1507 load them: the development window (decision days whose five targets fall on or before 2025-12-31) and the 2026 development days (five targets from 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-03). The 2026 days are shown on their own, as a window, and decide nothing
frame.walk: one sc.walk per window with the candidate and the arm, which share the base fit and #941's pool; the arms are compared on the same days. The study refuses to write a record unless every scored decision day has a forecast of each
frame.guards: a scored decision day or target day passes lockbox.require_unlocked through spread_mean_reversion_686.require_scored_days with the last day of the window; the blind tier (from 2026-09-04) and every lockbox day are refused; the scratch panel is refused unless its dates and published columns are the published panel's
frame.inputs: the published panel (digest 4ddc3882cd6d406b11e1088f8ff6195e16dde175a0ad6818abe40dd5bdac8999, built at 18:00) and the scratch panel of scripts/pressure_v1_1.py panel --end 2026-09-03 (same dates, plus on_rrp and bank_total_assets), from which only the two columns are built

primary.metric: grid CRPS (23 levels) averaged over leads h = 1..5
primary.also_reported: the Brier score of P(spread > +5 bp), as in #1483
primary.splits: pooled, by lead, by regime and by pressure-day type of the target day; groups of fewer than 20 days are listed and not tested

scoring.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (#655), the development tier: no verdict, no registration
scoring.test: scoring_protocol.paired_tests, the studentized stationary bootstrap (ruling 1), mean block 10 business days, 10,000 draws, seed 1526, two-sided 90% interval (the lower end is the one-sided 95% bound); the skill interval and the studentized interval on mean d are reported for every tested row; where the studentized bound cannot be computed the unstudentized percentile interval of mean d is given beside it, with no reading taken from it
scoring.reading: a reading is taken from the pooled mean-d bound (her ruling on #1009): R+S helps when the lower end of the 90% interval of mean d is above zero, hurts when the upper end is below zero, otherwise undecided

lead_1_dependence.what: the arm's miss-after-miss rate at lead 1 beside the candidate's, in the form of #1363 (scripts/candidate_calibration_1363.py): the 0/1 sequences of a miss of the central 90% band (strict) and of a miss above q95 (strict), over the scored decision days of lead 1 in order, no transition across a gap; P(miss after miss), P(miss after hit), longest run, Christoffersen's statistic and its permutation p (10,000 permutations, seed 1363)

kill: From #46's H7 line: the scarcity reading does not predict later spread behaviour beyond the current scarcity state. Reading 'undecided' or 'loss' on the pooled mean-d bound is a development reading, not a verdict. Because the candidate reads neither R nor S, the contrast cannot separate R from S: a gain is R+S together, a loss or an undecided reading says R+S as read here adds nothing to the candidate. Whether H7 is closed or registered is her decision.
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the candidate until she rules.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and pressure-day-type splits beside it.
The 2026 days are shown separately and decide nothing.
The study does not mark H7.M2 done: the milestone is marked, if it is, by her ruling on the page's marked question.
